patterns.backend_analytics: Productivity analytics pattern: create Python script in analysis/ directory, call via IPC handler using spawn(). Script outputs JSON with summary, trends, export options.
patterns.ipc_handler_pattern: IPC handlers in main/ipc-handlers/ use ipcMain.handle() with IPC_CHANNELS constant. Execute Python scripts via spawn() with augmented env vars.
patterns.dashboard_component: Dashboard components follow ProductivityDashboard pattern: useState for data, useCallback for loading, use Toast for notifications. Separate into card and chart components.
patterns.settings_component: Settings components use CollapsibleSection with Label + Select pattern. All state changes via onUpdateSettings callback.
patterns.i18n_pattern: Add translation keys to en/ and fr/ locales. Use namespace: t('namespace:key') pattern in components.

cost_tracking.description: Found existing cost tracking system in apps/backend/core/cost_tracking.py
cost_tracking.details: CostTracker class logs usage records with agent_type, model, tokens, cost, timestamp. Reads MODEL_PRICING dict with per-1M-token pricing.

model_configuration.description: Found model configuration system in phase_config.py
model_configuration.details: AGENT_DEFAULT_MODELS dict maps agent types to default models. Supports environment variable overrides AGENT_MODEL_<AGENT_TYPE>. Task metadata agentModels field for per-agent config.

agent_session.description: Found agent session tracking in agents/session.py
agent_session.details: AgentSession class manages SDK client creation and agent execution. Logs model used per session.

dashboard_ui.details: ProductivityDashboard uses summary cards and trends chart. IPC handlers call Python scripts via executePythonAnalytics().
